image_description: A close-up studio shot of a beaded necklace arranged in a loop on a plain off-white background. The necklace features alternating large metallic grey beads, smaller green faceted beads, and black matte beads. A central silver-toned pendant with an embossed floral or owl-like design hangs from the chain. There is faint text/watermark in the bottom left corner.
